notes: The tag-to-category mapping below is policy, not code. Re-running the ingest with a corrected mapping requires no schema change and no code change.

Water bodies are deliberately absent. A lake is only useful as a waterlogging signal through its shoreline, and this schema stores POIs as centroids; the centroid of a 1 km lake would be a misleading proximity anchor. Add it as a polygon table when waterlogging context is actually scored.

verification_points carry approximate, hand-entered coordinates. The expected_* fields are null until they have been confirmed against a real ingest; the acceptance test asserts them only when they are non-null, and reports what it actually found when they are null.

source.why_primary: The openstreetmap.fr Karnataka extract is 4x smaller than Geofabrik's Southern Zone and already covers the whole state, so it is a faster download and a shorter ingest for identical coverage of the target bounding box.

bbox.covers: JP Nagar, Banashankari, Jayanagar, Padmanabhanagar, BTM Layout and surrounds — the Bengaluru South wards this prototype scopes to.

roads.why_these: Every value a citizen can stand on and complain about, including footway (broken footpath is a real BSCC complaint category). Excludes track, path, cycleway, steps, construction and proposed, which either are not municipal responsibilities or do not exist on the ground yet.
